# 1.47.0-mod.2 (2026-10-22)

* Rename the Manager bundle to Hoodles Morphe Patches (Modded).
* Keep the Duolingo 6.102.4 patches and upstream Hoodles 1.47.0 patch payloads unchanged.

Update this repository source to receive the renamed bundle. If a custom source name is saved, use Sources > Rename to set Hoodles Morphe Patches (Modded).
